translated_output: 1. Change the location from the Control Software GCI Development Platform and clear the policy settings. This location shows the template that is known to hotsize large users. 2. Go to Policy Settings. Disable the following settings that apply Quality of Life (QoL) settings: 'Drying time,' 'Mail checking time,' and 'Checking remote print.' 3. Go to the location and configure Atemp-Coach (AT-C) to the time settings. Increase it to measure the CMU GPA 2 second lag (latch edge) from the printer's target value (e. g., 90.5 seconds). 4. Activate the settings that are beneficial for large printers: 'Remote monitoring and activation of quality of life (QoL) ' and 'Automatically checking and synchronizing the printing time.' 5. Activate the settings to avoid the need for synchronization and save the machine from the maximum speed of the printer.
